label: Standard deduction or itemized deductions
description: Form 1040 Line 12e standard deduction or itemized deductions (successor to line 12; guards the itemized side to the derived Schedule A composition whenever a Form 1098 statement is on record).

published_value.explain: Line 12e is the larger of your standard deduction and your itemized deductions.

computed_zero.explain: Line 12e is zero because neither your standard deduction nor your itemized deductions is above zero.

blocked.explain: Line 12e has no value yet. It is waiting for your standard deduction and your itemized deductions.
